'''Haxen Delto''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as a [[Colonel]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Alliance High Command]] on [[Yavin 4]], where he oversaw the communications specialists that scoured [[HoloNet]] and subspace transmissions for patterns and packets of usable intelligence<ref name="Visual Guide" /> as part of the [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service]]. [[Airen Cracken]] considered him the best source for eavesdropping on [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] transmissions. He provided a report to Cracken on several Imperial [[superweapon]]s.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

Colonel Delto also provided a report to General [[Davits Draven]] on his thoughts about the ties between [[Geonosis]] and the construction of an Imperial superweapon. Cracken tasked him with coming up with a concept that a [[kyber crystal]]-powered superweapon might take. He and his team came to the conclusion that the Empire might build a fleet of ships equipped with smaller cannons that combined would be more deadly than a single moon-sized planet killer.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> Haxen Delto served as one of the leaders of the Alliance forces during the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref> His methodical approach stood all in good stead.<ref name="Visual Guide" />
